content: If the transport protocol module calls PduR_<LoTp>CopyTx Data or PduR_<LoTp>CopyRxData with length zero ( PduInfoType.SduLength = 0 ) the PDU Router module shall return the size of the current available buffer or the current available data respectively.

If the Transport Protocol module calls PduR_<DstLoTp>Copy- TxData or PduR_<SrcLoTp>CopyRxData with zero length ( PduInfoType.Sdu Length = 0 ) the PDU Router module shall return the size of the currently available buffer or the currently available data respectively.
